lots.title: Planned, Preventative and Responsive Residential Property Maintenance and Compliance Services (Lot 10 of Building Services Framework 6278)
lots.description: Measured Term Contract executed under the JCT Measured Term Contract 2024 between the London Borough of Bexley (the Employer) and the Contractor. Initial term 1 November 2026 to 31 October 2030 (4 years fixed, no extension option). Scope covers planned, preventative and responsive maintenance services to residential properties owned or managed by the Council, including responsive repairs and minor works, void property refurbishment, general building maintenance, engineering repairs, gas servicing and safety inspections, electrical inspection and testing, fire and Legionella compliance inspections, emergency repair call-out services, pest control, rubbish clearance and waste disposal, and asbestos reporting and management works. Property portfolio: approximately 230 Council-owned residential street properties, 120 privately leased properties managed by the Council, and 3 hostels. The Employer reserves the right to vary the property count during the contract period. All works are issued via electronic works orders by the Contract Administrator with priority categorisation; no works may commence without a valid Order. This document is the Draft Terms & Conditions extract for Lot 10; the full contract pack additionally includes JCT MTC 2024 Conditions, Contract Particulars, Contract Specification, Schedule of Rates / Pricing Schedule, Property Schedule and any further referenced contract documents.
requirements: Execute the contract under the JCT Measured Term Contract 2024 incorporating Conditions of Contract, Contract Particulars, Schedule of Rates / Pricing Schedule, Contract Specification and all associated contract documents (Contract Form).
Initial Contract Term 1 November 2026 to 31 October 2030; 4 years fixed term with no extension option (section 2).
Provide planned, preventative and responsive maintenance services to residential properties owned or managed by the Council across the scope listed in section 3.

Service the stated property portfolio of approximately 230 Council-owned residential street properties, 120 privately leased properties managed by the Council and 3 hostels, recognising the Employer's right to vary property numbers during the term (section 4).

Accept all works via electronic works orders issued by the Contract Administrator; do not commence any works without a valid Order containing description, priority category, property location and (where applicable) cost allowance (section 5).

Meet priority response and completion times: Standard - response as programmed, completion within 5 working days; Urgent - response same or next day, completion within 1 working day; Emergency - immediate response, make safe within 4 hours; Small Void Works - completion within 10 working days; Large Void Works - completion within 28 working days; Emergency follow-on works to commence within 1 working day (section 6).

Comply with payment provisions under the Housing Grants, Construction and Regeneration Act 1996 and Section 4 of the JCT Measured Term Contract 2024, including monthly applications for payment, electronic submission of invoices, final date for payment of 30 days, VAT at the prevailing rate, and submission of all invoices within 6 months of order issue (section 7).
Achieve KPI 1 - minimum 90% compliance with response and completion times, measured monthly using works order data (section 8 KPI 1).

Achieve KPI 2 - maintain 100% statutory compliance across all properties for Gas Safety Certification, Electrical Safety Certification and Energy Performance Certification (zero tolerance) (section 8 KPI 2).
Achieve KPI 3 - small voids completed within 10 working days, large voids within 28 working days, with minimum 90% compliance measured monthly (section 8 KPI 3).

Comply with all applicable legislation including (without limitation) Building Regulations 2010, Building Safety Act 2022, CDM Regulations 2015, Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations, IET Wiring Regulations BS 7671, Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order, Environmental Protection Act and Data Protection legislation (section 9).

Comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, fulfil duties under the Construction (Design and Management) Regulations 2015, act as Principal Contractor where required, and maintain SSIP-accredited health and safety certification (e.g. CHAS) (section 10).

Undertake annual servicing of all gas appliances, carry out annual gas safety inspections, provide Landlord Gas Safety Records (LGSR), and provide a 24-hour gas breakdown service - all works compliant with the Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998 (section 11).
Ensure all staff hold relevant trade qualifications, valid CSCS cards, photographic identification and enhanced DBS clearance where required (section 12).
Dispose of all waste in accordance with the Environmental Protection Act 1990; act as a registered waste carrier and provide waste transfer documentation upon request (section 13).

Treat the following as forming part of the Contract: JCT Measured Term Contract 2024 Conditions, Contract Particulars, Contract Specification, Schedule of Rates / Pricing Schedule, Property Schedule and any further documents referenced in the Contract (section 14).
